The binding abilities of Ex-DARP and Ex-DARP-FGF21 to HSA were determined using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA)
study_type_evidence.section: METHODS (3.3. Binding Affinity of Fusion Protein for Human Serum Albumin In Vitro)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: male C57BL/6, eight weeks old, approximately 20 g; diet-induced obesity subgroup fed 60% kcal fat diet for 12 weeks
in_vivo_species.quote: Eight-week-old male C57BL/6 mice (approximately 20 g) were obtained from the Academy of Military Medical Sciences

in_vitro_detail: Plate-based ELISA with human serum albumin immobilized on 96-well plates, fusion proteins added at varying concentrations and detected with mouse anti-exendin-4 antibody plus HRP-conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG, to derive EC50 (half-maximal binding). Also SDS-PAGE and Western blot characterization. No cell-based receptor assay was reported.

bioanalytical_method: Sandwich ELISA (immobilized mouse monoclonal anti-exendin-4 capture antibody, rabbit anti-FGF21 detection antibody with HRP-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG), quantified against a standard curve; half-life from PKSolver in Microsoft Excel
bioanalytical_quote: an anti-exendin-4 mouse monoclonal antibody (Abcam, UK) was diluted with a carbonate-bicarbonate buffer (pH 9.6), immobilized in a 96-well plate
notes: Pharmacokinetics were measured only for Ex-DARP-FGF21; no half-life, Cmax, tmax or AUC is reported for Ex-DARP, and no clearance or volume of distribution is given for either. The PK construct retained its His-tag whereas the efficacy constructs were TEV-cleaved. The body contains a dose inconsistency for the DIO repeat-dosing study: Methods 3.6 states 25 nmol/kg every three days and the Figure 6 caption states 25 nmol/kg, but the Results text states 30 nmol/kg. A mutation inconsistency also exists: Methods 3.1 states FGF21 L98R and P171A, while the Discussion states L98R and P171G. No amino-acid sequence is printed in the body; only GenBank accessions and (GGGGS)3 linkers are given. Oral glucose (2 g/kg) is a challenge agent and is not listed as a test article.
